QUALITY STARTS WITH THE REQUIREMENT

The right questions.
A clearer specification.

Good material decisions begin with a shared understanding of the job. Bring your requirements to the conversation before confirming an order.

Application & grade

Cleanliness & washing

Discuss purity and water-washed options, including any limits on dust or fines required by your project.

Supply & access

Confirm quantities, destination, vehicle access, and timing so the supply requirements are clear.
